title: Homeadvisor vs Thumbtack vs Angi's: Lead Generation Programs Compared

facts.fact: The U.S. home services market was worth $595 billion in 2021, according to a research report cited by the page.
Creating a business profile on Angi's is free.
facts.quote: Creating your business profile on Angi’s is free.

facts.fact: Advertising on Angi's starts at around $300 per month, with pricing customized by services and location.
facts.quote: Advertising on Angi’s starts at around $300 per month.
You have to sign a 1-year contract for Angi’s ads.

facts.fact: Angi's charges a 35% early termination fee if an advertising contract is ended early.
facts.quote: A 35% early termination fee applies if you try to end the contract early.

facts.fact: On Angi's, a business needs a rating of 3.5 or better to keep its profile near the top of search results.
facts.quote: You need a 3.5 or better rating to keep your profile near the top of the search results.

facts.fact: Angi's certification requires maintaining a rating of at least 3 stars and undergoing a background check every two years.
facts.quote: Certification means maintaining a rating of at least 3 stars, keeping your licenses up-to-date, and undergoing a background check every two years.

facts.fact: Registration on Thumbtack is free for contractors, and contractors pay for leads when potential clients ask for a bid.
facts.quote: Registration on Thumbtack is free for contractors.

facts.fact: Thumbtack adjusts its lead pricing weekly.
facts.quote: Thumbtack adjusts its lead pricing weekly.

facts.fact: On Thumbtack, opportunity leads are paid for only if the potential customer responds to the contractor's offer.
facts.quote: You only pay for these leads if the potential customer responds to your offer.

facts.fact: HomeAdvisor is a pay-per-lead platform that also requires an annual membership fee to be listed, and it charges a lead fee even if the client does not choose the contractor.
HomeAdvisor's Market Match leads are shared with other service providers in the area, while Exact Match leads are exclusive to the company.
HomeAdvisor's system runs a background check plus sex offender, civil judgment, and state license screening before approving an account.
facts.quote: The HomeAdvisor system will conduct a background check as well as a sex offender, civil judgment, and state license screening.
